items.headline: Danaher completes acquisition of Masimo, which becomes a wholly owned subsidiary; company to update full-year 2026 guidance with Q2 earnings release
Masimo, a Danaher company, receives FDA 510(k) clearance for AI-enabled opioid-induced respiratory depression detection feature on Radius VSM wearable monitor
Danaher Board of Directors approves regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share, payable April 24, 2026
